title: Constant-factor hardness of directed feedback vertex set
main_claim: For every fixed A≥1, approximating minimum DFVS within factor A on unweighted digraphs is NP-hard (via a deterministic reduction from 2-to-1 games with imperfect completeness). The same holds for DFAS.

issues.description: The whole argument rests on the stated form of the 2-to-1 Games theorem with imperfect completeness: NP-hard 1-θ vs θ, constant alphabets, exact two-element fibers, and a rational edge law built by deterministic polynomial enumeration. The paper assembles this from DKKMS Thm 1.8, KMS Thm 1.12 (ECCC rev. 2) and BKS Thms 9–11. I did not check those external papers, so this is an unverified dependency, not a found gap.
issues.evidence: The paper says 'We invoke the completed theorem in this precise form', and its rationality/determinism remarks only cite sections of DKKMS.

coverage:
I read every section in full: construction, ranks, prefix, pivotality, soundness and unweighting. Checks made:
- Completeness: the Chernoff constant (1/2 − 1/e ≥ 1/8), the per-family deletion costs (total ≤ 4), and the real-valued potential argument, including the comparison index pairs (2,3), (2,18), (17,18).
- Rank-spreading lemma: the Ramsey colouring by conditional-probability intervals, minimax, and rational approximation.
- Goodness lemma: the pointwise ordering of A0..A3 and the arcs used.
- Monotonicity and prefix compatibility.
- Wildcard-forcing index arithmetic: c = 10d+15, usable triples, L = 10k_max+30.
- Prefix refinement and the lexicographic cut argument; E Y_i = (T/M) E h_u(p_i), giving E h_u ≥ p_i/4.
- Pivotality budget: I_p ≤ B and h ≤ pB via arrival times. The single-label forcing set identities, and the charge B_w/m_w × mass m_w.
- Dyadic Friedgut reduction: I_{1/2}(F) = 2kp·I_p, and the optimal predictor depends only on the AND values.
- Comparison charge: 2^{-T}·MD/K.
- List decoding: θJ².
- Junta decoupling: disjoint projection fibers make the juntas independent under the coupling, so the coupled and product laws agree; total error 10γ ≤ p_i/16.
- Tail sum: E B_v ≥ M/64 = 2(D+1), which contradicts the budget D+1.
- Parameter order (K → J → θ → m → η, N): not circular.
- Rounding/cloning (5S vs DS) and the DFAS gadget.
Sanity check: the YES-case dictators satisfy every intermediate bound except list decoding, as they should.
